messages:
tess: kicking off canary bump from 1% -> 3% for model inference v2026-03-19-rc3 (region: eu-west). preflight checks done, requesting go/no-go.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: service=inference, model=v2026-03-19-rc3, target=3%, current=1% -> initiating 2% step (3% planned). change-id=chg-3421

raja: seeing latency jump on eu-west between 12:34-12:36; p50 from 50ms -> 120ms. errors up 0.4% (baseline 0.05%).

tess: @raja can you paste the query pattern? is it long-context or more streaming?

raja: quick snippet of metric: ```region=eu-west p50:50->120 p95:90->320 qps stable. trace sample: long seq length spikes for a few requests, kvcache misses```

marco: could be kvcache cold start on new variant. suggestion: attenuate ramp to 1.5% and enable prefix cache warmup for 10m. also tilt batching size down to reduce head latencies.

anya: we can pin traffic for eu-west to v2026-03-19-rc2 (previous) while other regions continue. requires approval.

tess: opts: 1) proceed full 3% and monitor 10m 2) attenuate to 1.5% now and warm cache 3) pin eu-west back to rc2. leaning to 2.

raja: +1 for attenuate. error budgets are getting eaten.

deploy-bot: update: rollout paused at 1.5% due to manual throttle command. command: `/rollout throttle --service inference --target 1.5`

tess: applying warmup -> warming prefix cache for 8m. setting watch window 12m. @marco will monitor traces.

marco: watching. if p95 > 250ms or errors > 0.3% we rollback. putting alert: `alert: inference.latency.p95 > 250 for 2m`

deploy-bot: Canary snapshot saved: snapshot-id=snap-2456781234-1. pinned previous allocation for eu-west as fallback.

anya: added release note: 'attenuated rollout to 1.5% for eu-west due to kvcache cold misses; warmup in progress; follow-up 12:50 UTC'

tess: thanks. will reconvene after watch window. for now marking deploybot as 'attenuated' not 'paused'. :white_check_mark:

raja: FYI spike correlates with a specific customer query pattern, with seq_len > 12k. engineering follow-up ticket -> TICKET-9087.

tess: ok, schedule follow-up meeting if needed. closing thread for now, will reopen if alarm fires.
